title: Article 32 and the five writs
quote: Art. 32 = "the very soul of the Constitution and the very heart of it" - Dr. B.R. Ambedkar

boxes.title: Article 32: clauses
items: **32(1)**: move ==**Supreme Court directly**== - itself a **Fundamental Right** (APPSC GS 2025)
**32(2)**: directions, orders, **writs** (five named)
**32(3)**: Parliament may empower other courts - ==no such law==
**32(4)**: not suspended except as Constitution provides (**Art. 359**)
Only FRs; **original but not exclusive**; part of **basic structure**
Writs from **English common law** (prerogative writs)

boxes.title: Writ limits
items: **Mandamus** not against: private bodies, ==**President, Governors**== (**Art. 361**), discretionary duty
Mandamus can lie against govt company performing public function
No mandamus to make a law / in absence of policy (A-R G2 2025)
**Quo-warranto**: ==any public-minded citizen== can file; not for ministerial/private office
**Habeas corpus**: only writ directly against private individuals

items.what: SC to examine whether **ED** can invoke writ jurisdiction

boxes.title: PIL & res judicata
items: **PIL** relaxes locus standi; not itself an FR
**Epistolary jurisdiction**: letters as petitions (**Sunil Batra**)
HC dismisses **on merits** → no fresh Art. 32 on same facts; only appeal
Before 1950 only **Calcutta, Bombay, Madras** HCs issued writs

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: "Heart and Soul" = ==**Art. 32**== (G2 2025 key said Art. 14 → trap)
Match (G2 2025): quo warranto = by what authority; mandamus = we command
Produce detained person before court = **habeas corpus** (APPSC 2021)
Guardian of FRs = **Judiciary** (APPSC 2021)
Only SC and HCs issue writs; both issue **five**
